# T-3: Take coupon codes from coupons.json

Start URL: http://localhost:8091/
Landmark: Your cart

## Acceptance criteria

### Apply FALL15
Type FALL15 in the coupon field and click Apply.
Verify the order total shows $26.25.

## Notes

Marketing now keeps the live coupon codes in demo/app/coupons.json, so they can start and stop a campaign
without waiting for a developer. They added FALL15 for the autumn campaign (15% off the items), but the cart
says the code is not valid. The cart should take exactly the codes in coupons.json, so a code stops working
the day marketing takes it out of the file.
